Java Multithreading Mastery Problem Set

This roadmap is structured progressively:

Level 1 → Thread Basics
Level 2 → Thread Coordination
Level 3 → Synchronization & Locks
Level 4 → Advanced Locking
Level 5 → Thread Pools & Executors
Level 6 → Concurrent Collections
Level 7 → CompletableFuture & Async
Level 8 → Real-World System Design Problems

Each problem contains:

Problem Statement
Concepts Used
Expected Learning
Hint / Approach
Important APIs
